steps.title: Restart during an abandoned configuration build can overlap it
steps.what: Since the configuration is built off the main actor, a forced stop during preparation lets a new start begin while the abandoned build still runs. For a Linux machine with the serial console on, both builds bind the same console socket, so the second start may fail for the 150-300 ms window. Fix: keep the abandoned build and let the next start wait for it; add a test (hold preparation, force stop, restart, open the gate). Found by the chain B review.
